description: This file defines the ProductOptionValueDescription class, which extends Description and maps to the PRODUCT_OPTION_VALUE_DESCRIPTION database table using JPA annotations. It includes a many-to-one relationship to ProductOptionValue and provides getter and setter methods.

classes.description: Entity class representing the description of a product option value, linked to ProductOptionValue and stored in the PRODUCT_OPTION_VALUE_DESCRIPTION table.
